# Schema test fixtures

Generated by `pnpm fixtures:build` (`tools/fixtures/make-fixtures.ts`, spec 011 REQ-AST-021); do not
edit by hand. The rig, keyframe and leg-length documentation lives in
`packages/engine/test/fixtures/README.md`.

| Path                                                                                                 | Expected result                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `rigs/fixture-ue5-22.json`, `rigs/fixture-ue5-22-x.json`                                             | parse with `rigDefinitionSchema`                                          |
| `manifest.valid.json`, `clips.valid.json`, `character.valid.json`                                    | parse with `parsePartManifest`, `parseClipManifest`, `parseCharacterSpec` |
| `malformed/manifest-missing-license-author.json`                                                     | `parsePartManifest` fails, issue names `license.author`                   |
| `malformed/manifest-duplicate-part-id.json`                                                          | `parsePartManifest` fails (`duplicate part id`)                           |
| `malformed/manifest-unknown-rig.json`                                                                | `parsePartManifest` fails (`rig ... is not in rigs`)                      |
| `malformed/manifest-unknown-skeleton-group.json`                                                     | parses, `validatePartsAgainstRig` fails naming `skeletonGroup`            |
| `malformed/manifest-wrong-format.json`                                                               | `parsePartManifest` fails on `format`                                     |
| `malformed/manifest-skinned-without-rig.json`                                                        | `parsePartManifest` fails (`skinned part requires rig`)                   |
| `malformed/clips-missing-skeleton-group.json`                                                        | `parseClipManifest` fails on `skeletonGroup`                              |
| `malformed/character-missing-body.json`                                                              | `CMP_BODY_MISSING`                                                        |
| `malformed/character-future-version.json`, `character-bad-tint.json`, `character-body-in-parts.json` | `CMP_SPEC_INVALID`                                                        |
| `malformed/manifest-truncated.txt`                                                                   | not valid JSON (`.txt` so formatters skip it)                             |
